t: This module can be added to any module which handles $(italic)items/$ (as opposed to $(italic)blocks/$, $(italic)fluids/$ or $(italic)energy/$).$(p)Adding Stack Augments to a module increases the number of items it can process per tick; each Stack Augment doubles the number of items, up to a maximum of the item's natural stack size (64 for most items).
这个增强件可以添加到任何处理$(italic)物品/$的模块中（而不是处理$(italic)方块/$、$(italic)流体/$或$(italic)能量/$的模块）。$(p)向模块中添加堆叠拓展后，会提高它每 tick 可处理的物品数量；每个堆叠拓展都会使数量翻倍，最高可达该物品的自然堆叠上限（多数物品为 64）。

If the $(l:router/modular_router)router/$ also has $(l:upgrades/stack)Stack Upgrades/$ installed, the module's Stack Augments will override that; e.g. if a router has 6 Stack Upgrades, and a module has 2 Stack Augments, the module will process 4 items per tick, not 64.
如果$(l:router/modular_router)路由器/$本身也安装了$(l:upgrades/stack)堆叠升级/$，那么模块上的堆叠拓展会覆盖前者；例如，如果一台路由器装有 6 个堆叠升级，而某模块装有 2 个堆叠拓展，那么该模块每 tick 只会处理 4 个物品，而不是 64 个。
